FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Esotica Auto specialize in Range Rover and Land Rover?

Yes. Range Rover and Land Rover are among the core brands covered by Esotica Auto maintenance, diagnostics and spare-parts services.

Can I send the VIN for a spare-parts request?

Yes. The spare-parts page lets you send the vehicle details and VIN so our team can review the requested part and contact you.

Where are Esotica Auto branches located?

We have locations in Fifth Settlement, Third Settlement and Sheikh Zayed. See the Locations page for addresses and opening hours.
